### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1862d8d13039cff0f39a9670046fe8e08a9a4a6a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `0c2c418b83`
Local-runs: none

Scope: the net diff against the merge base (3 files, +92/−0):
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`, the Security tab item;
- the new `sys-user-security-tab-own-record.test.ts`;
- the changeset.

Read with them:
- the card #24938 with the claim 6312067923 and the dispatch 6312118832;
- the dev's `os-dev-report` 6313225946, read as claims;
- the PR body;
- the spec's `PageTabsProps` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`);
- objectui's `PageTabsRenderer` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The gate is declared where it is honoured: right.**
  - `PageTabsProps.items[]` declares `visibleWhen: EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.optional()` (`component.zod.ts:983`).
  - objectui's `PageTabsRenderer` evaluates it per item (`isItemVisible`, `containers.tsx:643`). An item-level `visibleWhen` drops both the tab header and its panel, and the renderer falls back to the first visible tab.
  - The value is ``P`has(record.id) && record.id == ctx.user.id` ``, the CEL envelope and `has()` guard the page's unverified-email `record:alert` already carries, for the reason that alert's comment gives: this raw `Page` literal reaches the wire verbatim, and only the `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope routes to CEL.
- **Gating the whole tab, not each section: right.**
  - The dev measured the tab to be entirely self-service. All seven actions it names (`change_my_password`, `change_my_email`, `enable_two_factor`, `disable_two_factor`, `generate_backup_codes`, `resend_verification_email`, `delete_my_account`) are own-record on the object, and nothing in the tab serves an administrator.
  - A per-node gate would leave an empty "Security" tab header on every other user's record, which is the same confusion in a smaller form.
- **Nothing else moves.** The actions and their own gates, the other tabs, the alert, and the viewer's own record are unchanged.
- **The pins have teeth.**
  - Four tests: the gate's envelope and source; that Security is the only gated tab; and that every action the tab names is itself own-record. The last is a guard that goes red if an administrator action is ever added to this tab under the own-record gate.
  - In the ablation (the `visibleWhen` line deleted) 2 tests go red. The blob was restored equal to `HEAD`.
- **Reported, not built:** the page's tab items carry no `value`, so the URL's `?tab=` token is derived from the item's index. On another user's record the API Keys and Preferences tokens shift down by one (`tab-9` → `tab-8`, `tab-10` → `tab-9`). Only a `?tab=` link copied from one's own record to someone else's is affected. The card excludes the other tabs, so this is noted in the PR, with no carrier. The seat agrees it meets no filing gate.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`: right for a page-metadata visibility gate, with no action, param, response, spec key or export moving.
- The changeset and the PR body carry the claim's `Clause-②: no (platform metadata only: …)` line verbatim, at a line start.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Cross-lane:** none. Every changed file is in `packages/platform-objects` or `.changeset/`.
- **objectui was read only**, from a blobless clone at the console pin; nothing was written there. The seat confirmed the renderer reading from its own read-only copy.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against today's `origin/main` (`8f59304ddc`) is clean.
- **Deviations, all accepted:**
  - the model-free commit trailers;
  - the objectui read through a clone, since the REST proxy refused it;
  - no browser reading taken (it was optional);
  - one gate pass superseded by the authoritative pass on the final head.
- **Open questions:** both are A, as the dev settled them: gate the whole tab, and leave the `?tab=` token shift as a note.
- **CI on `0c2c418b83`:** 17 of 38 check-runs still running at this read. The ACCEPT waits for green.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24938-security-tab-own-record`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`

**VERDICT: PASS**
